description:
Get details of a specific group.

Args:
  - server_url (string): Base URL of CKAN server
  - id (string): Group ID or name
  - include_datasets (boolean): Include list of datasets (default: true)
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format

Returns:
  Group details with optional datasets

Typical workflow: ckan_group_show → ckan_package_show (inspect a dataset) → ckan_datastore_search (query its data)

id.description: Group ID (UUID) or machine-readable name slug (e.g., 'transport', 'energia')

include_datasets.description: Include the list of datasets belonging to this group

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

server_url.description: Base URL of the CKAN server (e.g., https://dati.gov.it/opendata)

name: ckan_group_show
title: Show CKAN Group Details
